stories.title: BYD extends sales growth streak on strong exports
stories.summary: Chinese EV maker BYD posted a sixth straight month of sales growth in October, selling 490,168 vehicles as a 102.8% jump in overseas shipments offset sluggish domestic demand and intense price competition at home.

stories.title: Russian strikes cut power to hundreds of thousands in Ukraine
stories.summary: Russian strikes hit energy infrastructure in four Ukrainian regions overnight, killing one and injuring dozens while leaving hundreds of thousands of households without power, President Zelenskyy said. Ukraine's air force said it downed 371 of 433 drones launched since Saturday evening.

stories.title: Trump calls for replacing Zelenskiy after diesel-deal clash
stories.summary: Trump said Ukraine should get a new leader who can make a deal after criticizing Zelenskiy over a U.S.-Russia diesel agreement and Ukraine's strikes on Russian refineries. Zelenskiy said the diesel deal emboldened Moscow.

stories.title: Riots and looting overshadow Germany's youth protests
stories.summary: Hooded rioters looted stores in Frankfurt after tens of thousands marched across German cities demanding better education and lower living costs. Germany's interior minister threatened tough penalties for looters and rioters while praising the police response.

stories.title: Karpathy ships 'HackerTube,' a YouTube feed built from HN picks
stories.summary: Andrej Karpathy posted HackerTube, a YouTube feed built from videos recommended by Hacker News, which hit 544 points and the top of the front page within hours.

stories.title: Critical Linux TCP flaw (CVSS 9.8) still unpatched in Ubuntu, RHEL
stories.summary: CVE-2026-98432 is a remote use-after-free in Linux's IPv4 TCP handshake that an unauthenticated peer can exploit for kernel code execution. Upstream fixed it on Oct 15, but Ubuntu and Red Hat kernels remain unpatched, and the issue is trending on Hacker News.

stories.title: Team of five Qwen3.8-27B models beats Fable 5 on coding benchmark
stories.summary: An open-source workflow strings five Qwen3.8-27B models together as a team that beats the frontier Fable 5 model on the LiveCodeBench Hard benchmark. The demo, posted to GitHub, is trending on Hacker News.

stories.title: Browns aim to snap 20-year road losing streak in Pittsburgh today
stories.summary: Sunday's Dawg Chow rounds up Browns notes ahead of today's Week 8 trip to Pittsburgh, where a win would snap a two-decade road losing streak against the Steelers and push Cleveland's playoff odds above 65%.

stories.title: Ryan Day calls Ohio State's USC loss 'extremely frustrating'
stories.summary: Day blamed way too many mistakes for No. 2 Ohio State's 30-18 defeat at USC, played without injured quarterback Julian Sayin. The loss is a setback for the Buckeyes' playoff chase.

stories.title: USC stuns No. 2 Ohio State 30-18 in biggest win of Riley tenure
stories.summary: USC upset No. 2 Ohio State 30-18 in Los Angeles, with Jayden Maiava throwing for 222 yards and a touchdown as the Trojans improved to 7-2. The win keeps USC's College Football Playoff hopes alive.

stories.title: Lawson disqualified from Mexico City GP qualifying over technical breach
stories.summary: Liam Lawson was disqualified from Mexico City Grand Prix qualifying after Racing Bulls' car failed a technical check on its MGU-K. Stewards said the absence of any performance advantage could not prevent the disqualification.

stories.title: Hamilton takes first Ferrari pole at Mexico City Grand Prix
stories.summary: Lewis Hamilton secured his first pole position for Ferrari in Mexico City, ending a three-year wait and lifting his record to 105 career poles. He said the moment took him back to watching Michael Schumacher.

stories.title: Leclerc 'angry with myself' after losing pole to Hamilton
stories.summary: Charles Leclerc said he was angry with himself after losing pole to Ferrari teammate Hamilton in Mexico City qualifying and settling for third, while voicing overtaking concerns ahead of Sunday's race.

stories.title: Who is Patrick Havas, alleged attacker at Amy Acton campaign event
stories.summary: NBC4 profiled Patrick Havas, the man who allegedly approached Ohio gubernatorial candidate Amy Acton with a weapon at a campaign event. Weeks earlier, Acton had criticized a rival campaign that accepted a donation from Havas' brother.

stories.title: Columbus man reverses guilty plea in deadly road-rage shooting
stories.summary: A Columbus man who pleaded guilty in a deadly road-rage shooting has retained new counsel and is moving to reverse his plea, sending the case back to court.
